D3.description: Flatten the route-change decision chain by inlining the full policy-applies/apply logic directly into the wc_preclass_apply_route_change_block_or_skip call site inside wc_preclass_apply_route_change_finalize, then delete the three adjacent helper definitions wc_preclass_route_change_policy_applies, wc_preclass_route_change_policy_apply and wc_preclass_apply_route_change_block_or_skip

operations.pattern:
static int wc_preclass_route_change_policy_applies\(const wc_preclass_decision_fields_t\* out_fields\)?
\{?
	return out_fields && out_fields->route_change == 1 &&?
		!wc_preclass_action_route_change_allowed\(out_fields->action\);?
\}?
?
static void wc_preclass_route_change_policy_apply\(wc_preclass_decision_fields_t\* out_fields\)?
\{?
	out_fields->route_change = 0;?
	out_fields->fallback_reason = wc_preclass_route_change_fallback\(out_fields->fallback_reason\);?
\}?
?
static void wc_preclass_apply_route_change_block_or_skip\(wc_preclass_decision_fields_t\* out_fields\)?
\{?
	if \(wc_preclass_route_change_policy_applies\(out_fields\)\)?
		wc_preclass_route_change_policy_apply\(out_fields\);?
\}?
?
static void wc_preclass_set_decision_defaults\(wc_preclass_decision_fields_t\* out_fields\)

D4.description: Flatten the match-layer input-label chain by inlining the full output/input label logic directly into the wc_preclass_input_label_from_match_layer call site inside wc_preclass_resolve_decision_fields, then delete the two adjacent helper definitions wc_preclass_match_layer_output_label and wc_preclass_input_label_from_match_layer

operations.pattern:
static const char\* wc_preclass_match_layer_output_label\(const char\* match_layer\)?
\{?
	if \(wc_preclass_token_equals\(match_layer, wc_preclass_match_layer_cidr_compare_literal\(\)\)\)?
		return wc_preclass_match_layer_cidr_compare_literal\(\);?
	if \(wc_preclass_token_equals\(match_layer, wc_preclass_match_layer_ip_compare_literal\(\)\)\)?
		return wc_preclass_match_layer_ip_compare_literal\(\);?
	return NULL;?
\}?
?
static const char\* wc_preclass_input_label_from_match_layer\(const char\* match_layer\)?
\{?
	const char\* label = wc_preclass_match_layer_output_label\(match_layer\);?
	if \(label && \*label\)?
		return label;?
	return wc_preclass_non_ip_literal\(\);?
\}?
